published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead (follows its base build, rogue__combat-daggers), keeping the eurekaCp 0 rotation (Eureka! on cooldown, tuned for the Gnome; a no-op for other races); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 793.9 as Gnome on the same sim)

summary: Combat Daggers with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
keyTalents: Hack and Slash 5/5 (mace off hand: armor ignored)
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Eureka! (Gnome) on cooldown while Slice and Dice has 8s or more left
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer (Shadowmeld into Ambush for a Night Elf)
Backstab right after a main-hand swing (0.25s), or at 100 energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. Its flask gives its full bonus only there.
Takes the Flask of Natural Accuracy over Natural Precision, since its 5% hit still helps white hits (0.1 to 0.6 DPS).
9% hit (the wrist carries 10 hit rating): dual wielders take hit by sim (standards 4); 9% beats 8% by 1.1 to 1.8, and 10% is 0.6 behind to 0.1 ahead.
No Goblin Land Mine: its 1 sec cast resets the swing, so it loses DPS here. The Sapper stays.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__combat-daggers except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does. Request from mksettings -spec rogue_combat_daggers (the rogue_combat setup with the Flask of Natural Accuracy). Gnome since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (follows its base build, rogue__combat-daggers), with its base's rotation regenerated with eurekaCp=0 (Eureka! on cooldown). Was Windshaper Skyborne.
